newsitem.title: CHINA: China to build 13 new satellite ground stations.
newsitem.headline: China to build 13 new satellite ground stations.

text.p: China's Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications is to set up 13 satellite ground stations to boost the domestic telecommunications network, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
The satellite ground stations, to be set up in 13 cities, would add more than 50,000 high-speed telephone lines to the existing satellite telecommunications network, it said.
The new stations would take the total number of satellite ground stations to 37, covering all 30 of China's provinces, regions and cities, it said.
